name: Bodi Iyer Hotel (Cumbum gateway)
area: L.F. Main Road, Cumbum (Meghamalai gateway town, ~14km)
signature_dish: Pure-veg South Indian tiffin and meals with pure-ghee sweets
why_it_matters: A pure-vegetarian institution in Cumbum that has been serving for over 75 years — ranked #1 of Cumbum's veg restaurants on Tripadvisor with 170+ reviews. Cumbum is the main gateway town for the climb to Meghamalai, so this is the natural last proper meal before the hills. Known for fresh tiffin, meals and pure-ghee sweets.
insider_tip: Meghamalai itself has no restaurants — eat in Cumbum on the way up or down. Bodi Iyer is the established choice: go at lunch for the meals, or stop for tiffin and the pure-ghee sweets. Cash-friendly.
signature_address: Bodi Iyer Hotel (Sri Gopala Krishna Vilas), L.F. Main Road, Cumbum, Theni District, Tamil Nadu 625516

name: Hotel Karna (Chinnamanur gateway)
area: Thangappa Nadar Street, Chinnamanur (Meghamalai gateway town)
signature_dish: Tamil meals and biryani in the closest gateway town to Meghamalai
why_it_matters: A dependable town hotel in Chinnamanur — the closest sizeable town on the Meghamalai approach — serving Tamil meals, biryani and tiffin. With Meghamalai itself having no eateries, Chinnamanur is where many visitors base their meals.
insider_tip: Chinnamanur is the last town with proper restaurants before the Meghamalai climb. Hotel Karna covers veg and non-veg; go at lunch for meals and biryani. Plain, central and inexpensive.
signature_address: Hotel Karna, No 5 Thangappa Nadar Street, Chinnamanur, Theni District, Tamil Nadu 625515

name: Thambi Mess (Bodinayakanur gateway)
area: Kamaraj Bazaar Road, Bodinayakanur (Meghamalai gateway town, ~35km)
signature_dish: Parotta and kothu parotta with salna
why_it_matters: A well-regarded mess in Bodinayakanur — a Meghamalai gateway and cardamom-trade town — singled out for its parotta, kothu parotta and salna. A reliable meal stop for travellers approaching Meghamalai or Kolukkumalai from the Bodinayakanur side.
insider_tip: Bodinayakanur is the gateway if you are also heading to Kolukkumalai. Thambi Mess does parotta and kothu parotta best — an evening order. Opposite the sub-registrar office on Kamaraj Bazaar Road.
signature_address: Thambi Mess, Kamaraj Bazaar Road, Periyandavarpuram, Bodinayakanur, Theni District, Tamil Nadu 625513

name: Kannamma Multicuisine Family Restaurant (Theni gateway)
area: Cumbum Road, RMTC Colony, Theni (Meghamalai gateway, ~45km)
signature_dish: Biryani and chicken sukka in a family multi-cuisine restaurant
why_it_matters: A family multi-cuisine restaurant in Theni town, the district headquarters and a wider gateway for Meghamalai trips — reviewers praise its hospitality and flavourful biryani and sukka. A comfortable sit-down option for travellers passing through Theni.
insider_tip: Theni is ~45km from Meghamalai — a base or pass-through town rather than the hill itself. Kannamma's biryani and chicken sukka are the orders; portions can run small, so order accordingly.
signature_address: Kannamma Multicuisine Family Restaurant, 6 Cumbum Road, RMTC Colony, Palani Chettipatti, Theni, Tamil Nadu 625531
